name: chiwire
description: TypeScript monorepo for personal and business idea projects.

scripts.dev:contimiti: npm run build --workspace @chiwire/core && npm run build --workspace @chiwire/contimiti && npm run start --workspace @chiwire/contimiti
scripts.dev:bull-board: npm run build --workspace @chiwire/core && npm run build --workspace @chiwire/bull-board && npm run start --workspace @chiwire/bull-board
scripts.dev:vtacademy-api: npm run build --workspace @chiwire/core && npm run build --workspace @chiwire/valenstonic-academy-shared && npm run build --workspace @chiwire/valenstonic-academy-backend && npm run start --workspace @chiwire/valenstonic-academy-backend
scripts.dev:vtacademy: npm run build --workspace @chiwire/valenstonic-academy-shared && npm run build --workspace @chiwire/valenstonic-academy-frontend && npm run start --workspace @chiwire/valenstonic-academy-frontend
scripts.dev:radiobemba: npm run build --workspace @chiwire/core && npm run build --workspace @chiwire/db-migrate && npm run build --workspace @chiwire/radiobemba-shared && npm run build --workspace @chiwire/radiobemba && RADIOBEMBA_PERSISTENCE=memory RADIOBEMBA_BASE_DOMAIN=bemba.localhost RADIOBEMBA_PUBLIC_ORIGIN=http://localhost:3000 npm run start --workspace @chiwire/radiobemba
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build --workspace @chiwire/core && npm run build --workspace @chiwire/db-migrate && npm run db-migrate --workspace @chiwire/db-migrate --
scripts.db:migrate:vtacademy: npm run build --workspace @chiwire/core && npm run build --workspace @chiwire/db-migrate && npm run db:apply --workspace @chiwire/valenstonic-academy-backend
scripts.db:migrate:radiobemba: npm run build --workspace @chiwire/core && npm run build --workspace @chiwire/db-migrate && npm run db:apply --workspace @chiwire/radiobemba
